title: Stabilize full-suite test coverage and enforce the >80% coverage gate
description: Stabilize the full Vitest/Playwright suite so it passes reliably on a clean clone under nominal and constrained host load, add a per-file fallback that prevents false-red runs under memory pressure, and introduce a coverage gate that enforces the >80% success criterion across contracts, geometry, assembly, validation, render, and export modules.
deviation_notes: New track. The active reusable_rig_pose_library track repeatedly reports full-suite coverage as environment-red under host load (16.41/16.71/12.51 load, 5.7 GiB swap) with five files passing independently and two timeout-only. This track owns the suite-stabilization and coverage-gate capability rather than any one track's incidental coverage pass. It does not depend on any visual acceptance gate and does not modify automation-supervisor.py.

sprint.goal: Make the >80% automated coverage success criterion reliably measurable and enforceable, independent of host load.

stories.title: Stabilize the full suite under nominal and constrained load
Wire the gate into the quality workflow and refresh facts
